description: [Scenario 1: True Positive Critical DDoS] Massive incoming traffic spike from overseas botnet causing core network latency and severe packet drops.
[Scenario 2: True Positive High CPU & Memory] CPU spikes above 90% and memory above 80% leading to increased API error rates.
[Scenario 3: True Positive High CPU Alert] Critical system degradation: CPU usage has hit 98% and API response time is hovering around 1.5 seconds. Error rate is spike-trending.

[Scenario 4: True Positive Brute Force] Active brute force attack detected on the customer portal auth endpoint. Over 650 failed login attempts in the last 2 minutes with only 12 attacker IPs successfully blocked.
[Scenario 5: True Positive Unauthorized Access] Critical unauthorized access event on the admin dashboard console with 110 attempts from unregistered outside IPs.
[Scenario 6: True Positive Medium Port Scan] Coordinated sweeps detected probing multiple standard and DB ports over the last 10 minutes.
[Scenario 7: False Positive Suppressed Brute Force] Automated brute-force scan. WAF blocked most IPs, auth service latency is normal, system status remains healthy.
